admission.justification: A tree that lists invariants as rows or omits the record kinds would make a record unfindable without its identifier; the Records branch prevents that.

applicability: The Records branch of the Knowledge tree.
conditions: Families, decisions, assumptions and the other record kinds are listed one line each.
Invariants stay out of the tree; they are reached through their files and families.
exclusions: The 'without proof' list, which lists invariants on request.
statement: Families, decisions, assumptions and other pathless records appear by title under Records, while invariants remain outside that branch.
